I-tenant.en: Derive tenant and subject from the verified session. Enforce current tenant/ACL filters before retrieval and check current access again when a citation is opened. Never share content across tenants.
I-tenant.zh: 从已验证会话确定租户与主体。检索前执行当前 tenant/ACL 过滤，打开引用时再次核对当前权限；租户之间不共享内容。

I-approval.en: Approval binds tenant, subject, tool, canonical-parameter SHA-256 hash, expiry and idempotency key. Approval is a stored record, not model text. Reauthorize immediately before execution; reject stale, modified or cross-tenant requests.
I-approval.zh: 审批绑定租户、主体、工具、规范参数 SHA-256 hash、有效期与幂等键。审批是持久记录而非模型文本；执行前重新授权，拒绝过期、篡改或跨租户请求。

I-authority.en: Model output, retrieved documents and guardrails never grant authority. Guardrails filter content; deterministic BFF and gateway checks enforce permissions.
I-authority.zh: 模型输出、检索文档和 guardrails 均不授予权限。Guardrails 过滤内容，BFF 与网关的确定性检查执行权限控制。

I-delegation.en: The BFF is the confidential OIDC client (authorization code + PKCE; verifier stays server-side). The Agent Service is the authenticated token-exchange client. The enterprise AS must explicitly support the required constrained delegation (RFC 8693); this is an assumption, not a generic IdP promise.
I-delegation.zh: BFF 是机密 OIDC 客户端（授权码 + PKCE；verifier 保留在服务端）。Agent 服务是已认证的 token exchange 客户端。企业 AS 必须明确支持所需的受限委托（RFC 8693）；这是前提，不是任意 IdP 的通用能力。

I-tokens.en: AS issues BFF access token aud=application-api, sub=employee, and a downscoped agent subject token aud=agent-service. Agent exchanges only that valid subject token, authenticating as agent-client; AS issues tool token iss=enterprise-as, aud=mcp-tool-gateway, sub=employee, act=agent-client, tenant, permitted scopes and short expiry. Tools verifies signature/issuer/audience/expiry, delegation actor, tenant and current policy; reject before Service Desk on any mismatch. Tokens for Service Desk are separate scoped connector credentials, never forwarded model or BFF tokens.
I-tokens.zh: AS 签发 BFF access token（aud=application-api、sub=员工）及缩权的 agent 主体 token（aud=agent-service）。Agent 以 agent-client 身份认证，仅交换此有效主体 token；AS 签发工具 token：iss=enterprise-as、aud=mcp-tool-gateway、sub=员工、act=agent-client、tenant、许可 scopes 与短有效期。网关核验签名、issuer、audience、有效期、委托 actor、tenant 与当前策略；任一不符在工单调用前拒绝。工单使用独立受限连接器凭据，绝不转发模型或 BFF token。

I-idempotency.en: Persist execution intent and idempotency key before sending. Service Desk is assumed to support idempotent ticket creation by that key. After ambiguous timeouts reconcile by key; never blindly repeat a non-idempotent write.
I-idempotency.zh: 发送前持久化执行意图与幂等键。假设工单服务支持按该键幂等创建；超时结果不明时按键对账，绝不盲重试非幂等写入。

I-ingest.en: Version documents with source ACLs; retries are bounded and failures go to DLQ. Only completely indexed versions become searchable; revocation/tombstone updates invalidate search and citation access.
I-ingest.zh: 文档版本携带源 ACL；重试有界、失败进入 DLQ；完整索引的版本才可检索，撤权或删除同步失效检索与引用访问。

I-eval.en: Feedback starts in DS-app. A steward approves deidentified/synthetic export to DS-eval. Offline C-eval uses an evaluation-only identity and versioned prompt/model/dataset; no production tool writes. Gate promotions on quality, safety, latency and token-cost measures without claiming measured scores.
I-eval.zh: 反馈先存 DS-app。管理员批准去标识或合成数据导出至 DS-eval。离线 C-eval 使用评测专用身份及版本化 prompt/model/dataset，不可写生产工具；按质量、安全、延迟与 token 成本门禁晋级，不声称实测分数。

I-operator.en: Operators see service health and redacted telemetry, not tenant content by default. Logs omit raw tokens and document text. Admin changes are audited and do not bypass data-plane checks.
I-operator.zh: 运维默认只见服务健康与脱敏遥测，不获得租户内容权限。日志不含原始 token 与文档正文；管理变更审计且不绕过数据面检查。

I-bounds.en: Exactly three tools: catalogue.lookup, ticket.read, ticket.create. Write requests require the initiating employee approval within current permissions. No arbitrary scripts, procurement, autonomous refunds or unbounded agent loops.
I-bounds.zh: 仅三种工具：catalogue.lookup、ticket.read、ticket.create。写请求要求发起员工在当前权限内审批；无任意脚本、采购、自主退款或无限循环。

deployment.status: proposed teaching allocation; service availability and quotas must be checked before implementation
deployment.region: one supported AWS region, selected at implementation time; no cross-region model routing assumed

placement.C-web: S3 static origin + global CloudFront; executes in employee browser
placement.C-api: ECS Fargate desired >=2, one healthy task per AZ behind regional ALB
placement.C-agent: ECS Fargate desired >=2 across two AZs; internal HTTPS
placement.C-tools: ECS Fargate desired >=2 across two AZs; separate service identity
placement.C-ingest: ECS Fargate workers scheduled in either AZ from Q-ingest; idempotent version jobs
placement.C-eval: ECS Fargate scheduled task in either AZ; isolated evaluation IAM identity

stores.DS-app: Aurora PostgreSQL writer in one AZ, reader in other AZ; cluster storage across three AZs is service-managed, not a claim of three application AZs
stores.DS-index: OpenSearch provisioned domain, zone awareness across two AZs with replicas; not the distinct three-AZ Multi-AZ with Standby mode
stores.DS-doc: S3 regional versioned bucket outside customer subnets
stores.DS-eval: Separate S3 regional bucket/prefix policy, evaluation identity only
stores.Q-ingest: SQS regional queue and DLQ outside customer subnets

managed_services: Amazon Bedrock regional model endpoint outside customer subnets
CloudWatch regional redacted telemetry and cost measures
Secrets Manager regional scoped connector credentials
